messages:
talia: Heads-up — we're kicking off a small cross-team project to onboard routing/quota metrics into the dashboards. Need runtime + infra input on exporters, aggregation, retention, and an initial backfill plan. TL;DR: want per-route policy hit rate, quota throttle counts, and cost/latency breakdown by route.

raj: +1. Which runtime signals do you need? We already emit route_id, latency_ms, and token_count on serve logs.

talia: Need a few new ones: route_policy (enum), quota_eval (ok/limited/throttled), quota_bucket (tenant/route), and prefer token_cost estimate per request. Also a boolean cache_hit.

simon: runtime can push these from the serving layer. Two asks: (1) small schema change in the exporter (adds four fields), (2) a versioned rollout so we don't break older parsers.

maya: Also callout: exporter serialization currently batches protobufs every 5s. If we add enums we should keep payload < 1MB; otherwise we'll need to tune batch window.

raj: proposal for exporter config:
```
exporter:
  format: json
  batch_window_ms: 5000
  fields: [route_id, route_policy, quota_eval, quota_bucket, token_count, token_cost, latency_ms, cache_hit]
```

olivia: For aggregation: hourly aggregates for 90d, daily aggregates for 365d, and raw events kept 60d. Backfill: we can run a 180d backfill of hourly aggregates only (raw backfill expensive). Estimate: ~120GB compressed job output, ~8 CPU worker pods for 12 hours.

talia: That retention plan sounds reasonable. Question for infra: can the cluster take the backfill window next Tue? ENGOPS-2417 tentative slot.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window: Tue 2026-04-07 02:00-06:00 UTC. No new heavy jobs permitted without approval.

raj: If maintenance blocks us we can split into 3x 6-hour jobs. Also want to add a sampling flag to exporters so we can toggle full versus sample stream during rollout.

simon: Agree on sampling flag; we'll add `sample_rate` to exporter config and default to 1.0 for backfill, 0.1 for prod.

maya: On dashboards: product wants per-tenant quota throttle trend and a route-level 95th latency heatmap. Need naming conventions for metrics so Grafana queries are stable.

olivia: naming suggestion: redwood.runtime.<env>.route.<route_id>.<metric>. E.g. redwood.runtime.prod.route.generate_quota_throttles.count

talia: Action items:
- runtime: add fields + sampling flag + versioned exporter (raj/simon) — ENG-PLAT-1201
- infra: approve backfill window + provide node quota (olivia) — ENGOPS-2417
- analytics: create hourly/daily aggregation jobs & dashboards (maya) — DASH-88
- eng-platform: own rollout + docs + canary queries (talia)

Can folks ack and we'll split tickets?

raj: ack. I'll draft PR for exporter changes and add sample_rate toggle.

simon: ack. I'll include rollout notes and migration script to ignore unknown fields.

olivia: ack. I'll update ENGOPS-2417 with estimated resources and block time request.

maya: ack, will start dashboard skeleton and send sample queries.

talia: Perfect. I'll create the umbrella RFC and link tickets. Thanks :thumbsup:
